## Flagship Projects & Case Studies

### 1. Autonoma — Multi-Channel AI Support Agent
- **URL**: https://buildwithusman.me/projects/autonoma
- **Type**: Enterprise AI System
- **Description**: An enterprise-grade multi-channel AI support agent built with hybrid RAG knowledge retrieval, dynamic intent classification, autonomous ticket resolution, and human-in-the-loop escalation workflows.

### 2. CodeStick — Offline LLM Environment on USB
- **URL**: https://buildwithusman.me/projects/code-stick
- **Type**: Open Source & Portable Hardware AI Tool
- **Description**: A zero-install, zero-residue local AI coding assistant pre-packaged on a USB flash drive that boots offline LLM models (Ollama/OpenCode) on any host machine without installing host dependencies.

### 3. PayMyBread — Automated Payment Platform
- **URL**: https://paymybread.com

### 4. TextCorn Cleaner Bot — Telegram AI Moderation Bot
- **URL**: https://t.me/CornCleaner_bot

### 5. ghme — Interactive GitHub Profile README CLI Generator
- **NPM Package**: `npx @muhammadusmangm/ghme`
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/MuhammadUsmanGM/ghme
- **Type**: Open-Source CLI Tool

### 6. LoopGuard — Code Execution Safety Guardrail
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/MuhammadUsmanGM/loop-guard
- **Type**: Open-Source Security Tool
- **Description**: Runtime safety guardrail for LLM code execution environments that monitors infinite loops, memory leaks, and malicious system calls.
